name: Daily Summary
description: Summarizes the last day of git activity across the workspace into a short report.

name: Weekly Cleanup
description: Lists stale branches, leftover build output and large untracked files. Reports only, deletes nothing.

name: Reminder (one-shot)
description: A one-shot example: runs once at the time below, then switches itself off. Edit the date before enabling.

name: PDF Digest (event)
description: Event example: when a new PDF lands in your Downloads folder, Chronos starts a read-only run that summarises it. Edit the folder before enabling.
